1.title: Share the link
1.text: One link in the group chat. Voters need no account and no app.

2.title: See the result
2.text: Watch live who has voted and who hasn't. At the end, you have a decision.

ideas.heading: What people use Votean for
ideas.sub: Furnishing a living room for two or finding a travel destination for eight — same poll, same 30 seconds of effort.

wohnen.headline: Two opinions, one sofa.
wohnen.story: New apartment, empty living room. Instead of 40 screenshots in the chat, you create a poll, everyone votes at their own pace — and by evening the decision is made in black and white.
wohnen.question: Which sofa should we get?
wohnen.pt0: Photos, links and prices sit right next to the option
wohnen.pt1: Everyone decides independently — no influence on each other
wohnen.pt2: Multiple polls per room: sofa, lamp, rug

trip.headline: Six calendars, one weekend.
trip.story: First the date, then the destination. Two polls, one link in the group — and nobody has to scroll through 200 messages anymore.
trip.question: Where shall we go in September?
trip.pt0: Date poll finds the day when everyone can actually make it
trip.pt1: Join by link — just enter your email
trip.pt2: Reminder for everyone who hasn't voted yet

geschenk.headline: One gift, no duplicates.
geschenk.story: Collect five ideas, everyone votes, the two with the most votes get bought. And the person being gifted simply doesn't see the poll.
geschenk.question: What should we give Yuna?
geschenk.pt0: Ideas come from everyone, not just the organizer
geschenk.pt1: Budget as a note on the poll

team.headline: Decide instead of postpone.
team.story: The kick-off date, the summer party, the new tool: short poll, clear deadline, visible result. No meeting loop, no email chain.
team.question: When shall we do the offsite?
team.pt0: Set a deadline — the poll closes automatically
team.pt1: Interim results only visible after casting your own vote
team.pt2: Share the result as a link in Slack or email

authPitch.sub: No password, no profile, no credit card. We send you a 6-digit code — enter it once and you're in.
